label: B25-STANDARD-SERVER-RESCAN-CONTROL
title: Corrected B25 first-terminal control after delayed read-only standard-server rescan
triggered_by: T-20260920-001 found no modeled production defect, while T-20260920-003 proved that delayed read-only jtagconfig rescans can restore JTAG UART enumeration without restarting the standard server

authorization.user_statement: 好，我们继续，许可使用Quartus和JTAG来烧写和测试设备。
authorization.scope: One bounded volatile configuration of the frozen corrected SOF, delayed read-only standard-server enumeration, then one ordinary-file-input terminal session; safe golden volatile rollback on failure.
excluded: stopping or restarting standard server PID 5640

scope:
Program the exact accepted corrected SOF through the existing volatile path. After stopping only the task-owned programming server, preserve standard PID 5640 and run delayed read-only jtagconfig -n scans until the candidate device and JTAG UART #0 are explicitly visible. Do not open a console probe. The next and only terminal uses the historical ordinary-file stdin bytes '?
p
Z
'.
acceptance: Programmer exit 0 plus checksum/JTAG-ID match; read-only enumeration identifies the candidate and JTAG UART #0 without a server restart; the first terminal connects, receives BOOT/CAL/DDR/READY, returns a CLOCK25 status line and PONG, and echoes Z. Hash-bind enumeration, input, stdout, process ownership and final state.
failure_policy: This is one bounded new server-state control, not a repeat of T-002. Preserve failure evidence and restore the content-addressed golden SOF through the same volatile path without opening another terminal. Do not reset, power-cycle, write Flash or restart PID 5640. On failure, proceed to a separately registered physical RX observability task.
resource: Every remote, programmer, enumeration and terminal action acquires gamepc. One foreground task-owned programming server, one programmer and one terminal; return 75 means wait. Stop only recorded task-owned PIDs.

result.safety: No Flash/JIC/EPCQ, reset, power action, server restart or unknown-process stop; gamepc FREE
result.next: Implement T-20260920-005 physical DATA-read/RVALID/last-byte observability; do not repeat host-method controls.
